newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle prices mixed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle prices mixed - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady to firm, except steers under 400 lbs $4.00-$6.00 per cwt lower and heifers over 600 lbs steady to $2.00 higher, compared to Monday, USDA said.

Not enough slaughter bulls on offer for a market test. Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 300-600 lb feeder steers and heifers. Supply included around 8 percent slaughter cows and bulls; 15 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs with balance mostly feeder cattle under 600 lbs.
Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 69.00-76.00, pkg 80.50; 700-775 lbs 70.00. Medium and Large 1-2 - 500-700 lbs 66.25-73.25; few 700-850 lbs 63.50-66.00.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 68.25-76.50; two pkgs 700-725 lbs 68.00-70.00. Receipts - 745 Last Week - 523 Last Year - 914
